# solmargintrader

> SOL trading research and execution tooling in four parts: an offline backtester, strategy research, a Chrome MV3 grid-trading extension (dry-run by default), and a read-only macOS menu-bar/TUI console. Research and educational tooling, not financial advice.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): Four components, quick start, three-surfaces-one-registry design, findings that shaped the extension
- [docs/onboarding.md](docs/onboarding.md): A first hour that ends with every component run
- [docs/codebase-overview.md](docs/codebase-overview.md): File map for all four components
- [docs/COMPONENTS.md](docs/COMPONENTS.md): What each module does and depends on

## Components

- [backtester/README.md](backtester/README.md): Offline event-driven backtester for spot and leveraged perps, with a modelled borrow fee and no live trading
- [extension/README.md](extension/README.md): Chrome MV3 grid trader on Jupiter with risk rails and P&L tracking
- [soltui/README.md](soltui/README.md): Textual TUI and macOS menu-bar indicator over the backtester; no order path
- [research/STRATEGIES.md](research/STRATEGIES.md): Strategy survey built on the backtester

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Component map, the tick, restart safety, venue seam
